mainEntity.name: Copyfy or Anstrex: which one is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: product research, store analysis, product pages and going live. Anstrex is better if you only want to spy on native, push and pop ads across dozens of networks. To launch and run a store, Copyfy wins; for pure native ad spy, Anstrex stays strong.

No. Copyfy starts at 49€/month with a 5-day free trial and no credit card, while Anstrex charges 69,99$/month. For a comparable scope Copyfy stays cheaper, since it covers product research, store analysis and store creation where Anstrex only handles native and push ad spying.

mainEntity.name: Which has the better product research?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy, no question. Its AI targets winning products directly and analyzes competitor stores, where Anstrex infers trends from native and push ads. To move fast toward a product to launch, Copyfy's approach is more direct.

For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers product research, competitor analysis, AI product pages and Shopify integration. Anstrex keeps the edge on the depth of its native and push ad base: if intensive ad spying is your core business, it pairs well with Copyfy.

mainEntity.name: Can you test these tools for free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy offers a 5-day free trial, no credit card, plus a 5-day free trial. Anstrex, for its part, offers no free trial: you have to pay from the start. So the simplest move is to test Copyfy for free to see if the suite covers your need.
